reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with how Udemy has handled my account suspension.

My account was suspended because of an alleged security or verification issue involving Stripe, a third-party payment service. The frustrating part is that I have made my purchases legitimately, I have no late payments, and everything I bought on Udemy was fully paid for.

I use Udemy regularly for my studies, so suddenly losing access to my account has seriously disrupted my ability to study and continue the courses I paid for.

What makes this even worse is the lack of useful support. Instead of Udemy actually helping resolve the suspension, I was essentially directed toward the third-party payment provider. From a customer’s perspective, that is extremely frustrating. My account, courses, and purchases are with Udemy, yet I’m being left to chase down another company just to figure out why I can no longer access something I already paid for.

I understand that security checks are necessary, but suspending a paying customer’s account without providing a clear explanation, a straightforward resolution process, or meaningful assistance is unacceptable.

At this point, the experience has been incredibly inconvenient and disappointing. I simply want access restored to the courses I legally purchased and a clear explanation of what caused the suspension in the first place.

reviews.title: I love Udemy, but the app is atrocious.
reviews.text:
I love Udemy on my desktop, and I use it almost daily. Because I enjoy Udemy so much and want to see it succeed, I am going to be brutally honest in my review of this app. 

This app is essentially unusable for learning. Finding the course or video I want to watch is extremely counter-intuitive. There isn’t even a “continue where you left off” option. 
Today, when I finally found my location in my course and finished that video, instead of going on to the next video in the course it went to another video in a completely unrelated subject/course. How in the world is that even a  useful autoplay feature for an education based app? 

I’m truly baffled how the app is so entirely different (and immensely worse) than the browser version. 

Please, Udemy, fix this. Hire any number of the instructors you have on here or someone to make the app intuitive and usable. 

I’m thoroughly disappointed in how much of an afterthought the app seems to be for Udemy.
